items.detail: Three tankers were struck by projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday (Reuters/UKMTO), with a publicly stated US retaliation doctrine. WTI closed ~$92.87 (+2.7%) and Brent ~$102.31 (+4.4%); the EIA's 9/25 week showed distillate stocks 14% below the five-year average — the tightest datum in the complex. The 10Y hit 5.347% intraday, a 24-year high, before closing ~5.233%; the 2Y sits at 4.79%. A 5.3%+ 10Y is the sharpest discount-rate headwind to the growth names.
